title: Lemon Herb Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender ingredients and a hint of lemon. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the herbal broth, lemon juice, salt, and parsley.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
